# Smart Coir Manufacturing & Supply Chain System

> Smart Coir is an AI-powered smart manufacturing, quality control, inventory management, and supply chain ecosystem for coir product producers and buyers.

## Key System Modules & Features

- [Client Portal Dashboard](/client/dashboard): B2B ordering, real-time shipment tracking, inventory status, and order history.
- [Product Inventory Catalog](/client/inventory): Coir pith, coir fiber, coco peat blocks, coir geotextiles, and custom dimensions.
- [Order Management](/client/orders): Automated invoice generation, shipment tracking, and logistics updates.
- [Live Support](/client/contact): Direct assistance for wholesale supply, technical specifications, and bulk quotes.

## Technical Stack & API Overview

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (React 19), Webpack, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend API**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (Mongoose), Socket.io, JWT Authentication
- **AI Integrations**: OpenAI API for intelligent supply chain assistance and automated support
- **Export Capabilities**: PDFKit invoice generation, QR Code product tracking
